rationale: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry or Evaluator feedback, so this is a conservative baseline built from the contract physics. Geometry: five 8 mm sensors spaced 12 mm apart across x = -0.024 to +0.024 m, so the 25 mm tape is always covered by at least two or three sensors, with a 12 mm pitch giving smooth interpolation of the line position. Sensors sit 0.03 m ahead of the axle so steering reacts before the wheels reach the line. Weights are proportional to sensor x (2, 1, 0, -1, -2), so the signal is roughly the line offset in units of 12 mm and positive signal (line on the left) steers left as the contract requires. Controller: base_speed 1.6 (PWM about 80%) to reach the roughly 1.5 m/s average needed to finish in under 3 s while leaving headroom for turns. kp 2.0 gives a moderate correction (signal 1 gives 700 PWM of differential). kd 0.1 damps oscillation without amplifying sensor noise. ki 0.05 is a small integral term to remove steady bias from the motor mismatch. line_loss last_direction keeps the robot turning the way it was going when the line is lost. Expected result: completion on the oval and s-bend, with moderate rms_error. If the slalom or sharp bends cause line loss or oscillation, the next revision should raise kd, lower base_speed, or widen the sensor array.
